issues.legal_issue: A finding in earlier litigation that a joint family had disrupted and its business had become a partnership barred a later suit seeking a declaration of continuing joint-family status and a share in the family business and property.
material_facts: The later suit sought a declaration that the claimants remained members of a larger joint Hindu family and were entitled to a share in its business and property.
In an earlier injunction suit, a claimant had specifically argued that the larger joint family continued to exist and that its business belonged to that family.

The earlier courts specifically decided that the larger family had disrupted, that the brothers had separated, and that they thereafter carried on the business as partners; that finding was necessary to decide the earlier suit and was upheld through the appellate courts.
An earlier award decree had also resulted in partition by metes and bounds.
issues.conclusion: The earlier finding operated as res judicata and barred the later suit against the parties to the earlier litigation or their predecessors; the appeal was dismissed. The claimant remained free to proceed with the suit against his own father.
issues.legal_principle: Under the doctrine of res judicata, a finding on a specific issue that was raised and necessarily decided in earlier litigation between the parties or their predecessors binds a later suit in which that issue is raised again. The Court relied on the prior courts' specific and necessary determination; it cited no statutory provision or earlier case.

rule.if: subsequent_joint_family_share_claim and earlier_litigation_between_parties_or_predecessors and same_issue_specifically_raised and necessary_final_finding_on_same_issue

predicates.subsequent_joint_family_share_claim: The claimant brings a later suit seeking recognition of continuing joint-family status and a share in family business or property.
predicates.earlier_litigation_between_parties_or_pr: The earlier litigation involved the same parties or their predecessors.
predicates.same_issue_specifically_raised: A party specifically raised in the earlier litigation the issue that is presented again in the later suit.
predicates.necessary_final_finding_on_same_issue: The earlier courts made a final finding on that issue that was necessary to decide the earlier litigation.

issues.definition: When a later joint-family share claim repeats an issue specifically raised and necessarily determined in final earlier litigation between the parties or their predecessors, the later claim is barred by res judicata.
